title: A failed save is reported once per cause until a save lands; a page hide still tries the save each time
evidence: Root fix R20 (US-09 AC58), owner's ruling 2026-11-26. The reporting half is met: shouldReport in packages/health-core/src/record-host.ts keys each failed-save report by cause and grant and clears when a save lands, so a repeat is sent with repeat: true and the web host keeps it out of Sentry. The older triggers still try the save on each hide by design: one attempt per hide, the last chance to save (US-10 AC5; widget-src/src/storage/roadmap-store-hide-refused.test.ts). Left: the iPhone half, ios/engine/cloud.ts, whose host does not read repeat. Tests: record-host.save-report.test.ts, record-session.retry.test.ts
